description: Two gku hooks. review-report.sh sends a gku:reviewer answer that names a blocker back once when it wrote no report — /gku:review's step 5b, enforced; it fires for gku:reviewer only. second-opinion-offer.sh tells the session that started /gku:review which agents could give a second opinion, so it asks once the review is back; for any other prompt or skill it exits at once, silent.
